description: Inventory of backend features, API endpoints, services, models and utilities

endpoints.description: Check whether a user exists by email
Register a new user (validates email & phone uniqueness)
Login using OAuth2 form - returns JWT access token
Create and send OTP to email or phone
Verify OTP for email or phone and mark verified on User
Create a property (owner) - auto generates title if missing
Search/list properties with filters, sort and pagination
endpoints.request: query params (city, type, listing_type, min_price, max_price, bedrooms, furnished, sort_by, page, limit)

endpoints.description: Get property by id and increment views
Update property (owner only)
Delete a property (owner only) and remove images from filesystem
Bulk delete properties by IDs (owner only) with path validation for images
Radius search using Haversine formula with pre-filtering via bounding box
Search properties within a polygon (geofence) using bounding box for DB filtering
Debug endpoint - sample properties (limit 5)
Debug counts and sample cities
Get current authenticated user's profile
Update current user's profile fields
Delete current user and associated property images from filesystem
List properties owned by current user
Create inquiry for a property (prevents owner and duplicates)
List inquiries made by current user
List inquiries for properties owned by current user
Bulk delete inquiries belonging to the current user
Delete a specific inquiry belonging to current user
Update an inquiry (only property owner may update inquiries on their properties)
Get wishlist items for current user with property details
Add a property to wishlist
Remove a property from wishlist
Check whether a property is favorited by current user
Get latest notifications for current user (limit 20) + unread count
Mark a notification as read
Mark all unread notifications as read
Derive list of unique contacted owners from user's inquiries
Generate referral code for current user (formatted PROP{user_id:06d})
Return mock referral stats (stubbed)
Compute points for user based on activities (properties listed, inquiries)
List available rewards (static list)
Build user activity timeline from inquiries and listings
Fetch property visits for current user (PropertyVisit model)
Fetch rental agreements for current user (tenant) and return formatted agreement info
Rule-based chatbot responding to common queries and returning suggestions

services.auth: Token verification, HTTPBearer dependency, get_current_user, get_current_active_user
services.otp: OTP generation, create_otp (stores in DB), verify_otp, send_email_otp (SMTP with dev fallback), send_sms_otp (mock)
services.permissions: require_owner and other permission helpers (used in properties)

core_components.security: password hashing (bcrypt via passlib), create_access_token & verify_token using jose.JWT
core_components.database: SQLAlchemy engine, session dependency get_db, Base metadata auto-create in main.py
core_components.config: settings for environment, secret_key, upload_dir, allowed_origins, email config, token expiry

utils_and_other.file_handling: uploads mounted as static directory; secure_file_path used to validate file paths for deletion
utils_and_other.tests: pytest test suite covering auth, properties, otp, permissions, integration and more

notes.otp_dev_behavior: OTP is printed / returned as success when email config is not present (development convenience)
notes.referrals_and_rewards: Referral stats and some reward endpoints are stub/mock implementations not backed by persistent tables
notes.chatbot: Simple keyword based responses; intended for lightweight assistant, not an LLM integration
notes.security_considerations: Login mitigates timing attacks via dummy hash and minimum processing delay; JWT & bcrypt used; further production hardening recommended
